 Atletico Madrid v Barcelona (20:00 BST) 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter in Madrid 
 This match features 14 World Cup winners across the two squads - the most of any fixture in club football. 
 Barca have eight World Cup winners, the most of any club in the world right now, while Atleti have six world champions, the second-most of any club right now.

 It's tight at the top published at 19:56 GMT 19:56 GMT 
 Atletico Madrid v Barcelona (20:00 BST) 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Metropolitano Stadium 
 At the moment, Real Madrid and Barcelona are equal on points at the top of the table with Real having played one more game. 
 Atleti sit two points behind them both so if they win tonight, they go straight to the top of La Liga and what an impact that would have on the title race heading into the international break.

 Diego Simeone makes one change as Koke comes in for Morten Hjulmand.

 2 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:51 GMT 19:51 GMT 
 Atletico Madrid v Barcelona (20:00 BST) 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Metropolitano Stadium 
 Barcelona are on brilliant attacking form. They're scored 46 times in just 11 league matches including nine goals in their last two games.
 But this could be one of their toughest fixtures yet.
 Atleti have the best defensive record in the league. 
 Not only that, the Metropolitano is a very tough stadium to visit. Diego Simeone's side will look to make life for Barcelona very difficult this evening.
